title: Shoppers can't pick a size: 'Size' gets rage clicks and Add to Cart is pressed without a size

quotes: It keeps saying select a size but I don't see any sizes.
I tapped the size box but nothing opens. I can't pick a size.
There's a 'Size' label but no sizes I can choose.

suggestedFix: Show every size as a visible button that works on tap and without hover, and say which size is missing when Add to Cart is pressed.

title: Mobile shoppers and Desktop shoppers leave at Account, a step the flow doesn't require; 9 failed 'account_submitted' submits (password, confirmPassword, phone)

quotes: Why do they need my date of birth to sell me a shirt?
It wants me to create an account first.
Forced to create an account with a password and birth date. I'm out.

suggestedFix: Make Account optional (e.g. continue as a guest; offer it after the purchase): it isn't a required step, and its form fails people.

title: Large-text users can't find 'Continue to payment' on Shipping: rage clicks around it, then they leave

quotes: Where is the next button? I give up.
I filled everything in but I can't find a button to continue.
Now the shipping form. Filling in my address.
The form went blank after I added the discount code.

suggestedFix: Make 'Continue to payment' a high-contrast, full-width primary button with readable text (at least 16px, WCAG AA contrast).

title: Rage clicks on button.bg-[#31344F].rounded-full.w-9.sm:w-10.h-9.sm:h-10.flex.items-center.justify-center[type="button"] at Browse

quotes: I tapped the color and nothing happened. I can't narrow this down.
I picked Blue but the list didn't change. The filters don't work.
I see a list of products. Looking for a blue t-shirt.

suggestedFix: Make 'button.bg-[#31344F].rounded-full.w-9.sm:w-10.h-9.sm:h-10.flex.items-center.justify-center[type="button"]' respond visibly on the first click (state change, feedback or navigation).

title: Applying a promo code wipes the shipping form: the next submit fails on 5 fields

quotes: The form went blank after I added the discount code.
Now the shipping form. Filling in my address.

suggestedFix: Keep the shipping form's values when a promo code is applied (don't reset or re-mount the form), and keep the code applied.
